build_VitHead_decoder: build a VitHead decoder with deconvolution and convolution layers for ViT semantic segmentation
create_make_conv_layers: create convolutional layers with InstanceNorm2d and SiLU activation for feature processing
create_make_deconv_layers: create deconvolutional upsample layers with configurable kernel sizes 2, 3, or 4
run_forward_VitHead: run the forward pass through deconv and conv layers to produce segmentation logits
review_VitHead_loss: review the VitHead loss computation method that returns loss dict and segmentation logits
